description:
The gf2-core integration test `tuning_conservative_cfg.rs` compiles only when the `tuning-profile` feature accompanies `test-support`, although its own gate names `test-support` alone, so a partial-feature test run of the crate fails to build.

## Background

`crates/gf2-core/tests/tuning_conservative_cfg.rs` opens with `#![cfg(feature = "test-support")]` and includes `tests/support/core_tuning.rs`, whose `prepared_core_json` needs the tuning-profile machinery. The CI contract builds with `--all-features`, so the mismatch stays hidden there and appears only in focused runs such as `cargo nextest run -p gf2-core --features simd,test-support`, which a survey worker used to run the carry-less product conformance suite.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `cargo nextest run -p gf2-core --cargo-profile ci-test --profile ci --features simd,test-support` builds, with the tuning test either gated on every feature it needs or its support module made independent of the missing feature.
- [hard] REQ-02: The all-features fast tier still runs the test.

## Notes

Surfaced by the public wide carry-less product routing work while running its conformance tests with a focused feature set.
title: Gate the conservative tuning test on every feature it needs
